title: Regulating large car rental fleets and protecting private-hire drivers after Autobahn's collapse
asked: Ms Yeo Wan Ling asked whether LTA should regulate owners of large rental car fleets, given the impact on private-hire drivers' livelihoods if such companies become financially distressed or insolvent, and how LTA will work with tripartite partners for an orderly transition and to safeguard drivers' livelihoods.
response: Ms Sun Xueling said LTA worked with the National Taxi Association, the National Private Hire Vehicles Association and point-to-point operators to help drivers affected by the Autobahn failure secure other vehicles and earning opportunities, and that NTUC has a legal clinic for contractual advice. She said regulating car fleet owners can increase compliance burden and ownership cost for private hire vehicles, which could be passed through to drivers and passengers. LTA will work with the associations to raise drivers' awareness of rental contract terms and will set up a workgroup to review the vocational licence curriculum, including the Platform Workers Act. She said the matter is before the High Court and affected drivers, as unsecured creditors, are likely to face difficulties getting deposits back.

key_points.point: LTA worked with NTA, NPHVA and point-to-point operators to help drivers affected by the Autobahn failure secure other vehicles and earning opportunities
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: the Land Transport Authority (LTA) worked swiftly with the National Taxi Association (NTA), the National Private Hire Vehicles Association (NPHVA) and the point-to-point (P2P) operators to help affected drivers secure other vehicles and earning opportunities

key_points.point: NTUC has a legal clinic providing legal advice to members, including on contractual issues
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) also has a legal clinic to provide legal advice to members, including on contractual issues

key_points.point: Regulation can raise compliance burden and ownership cost for private hire vehicles, which could be passed through to drivers and passengers
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Regulation can result in increased compliance burden and ownership cost for private hire vehicles which could likely be passed through to drivers and passengers.

key_points.point: LTA will work with the associations to increase drivers' awareness of their rental contract terms
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: LTA will work with the associations to increase drivers' awareness of their rental contract terms

key_points.point: LTA will set up a workgroup to review the vocational licence curriculum, including the Platform Workers Act and its protections, and is open to including education on contractual matters
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: LTA will set up a workgroup to review the vocational licence curriculum and this review of the curriculum will include the recent Platform Workers Act and its relevant protections.

key_points.point: Affected drivers are unsecured creditors in a matter before the High Court and are likely to face difficulties getting their deposits back
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: The matter is now before the High Court, but because these drivers are unsecured creditors, it is likely that they will face difficulties getting their deposits back.

key_points.point: LTA and the associations worked with GrabRentals and CDG Rent-A-Car so affected drivers could secure new vehicles at good contractual terms
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: quickly work with GrabRentals, CDG Rent-A-Car, to make sure that the affected drivers are able to secure new vehicles at good contractual terms

key_points.point: On the suggestion of MOM short-term financial assistance, she said she would consult MOM colleagues
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Let me consult with my MOM colleagues.

left_open: Whether owners of large rental car fleets will be regulated
Whether large rental fleet owners will be required to ring-fence driver deposits
Whether MOM short-term financial assistance will be extended to affected drivers
supplementary: Supplementary questions covered rental contract terms and literacy, ring-fencing of driver deposits, and possible financial assistance for affected drivers.
